name: lk
description: Liam Klyneker's personal Claude Code skills: the grills that interview a plan until every branch is resolved, plus pinpoint, scoped-context, his writing voice, report, which files a session's conclusion about a skill as a sanitized issue on the skills repo, and human-review, which walks a reviewer through one pull request and posts the one review they approve, and proposal-review, which reviews a proposal or standards PR by its effect on the projects it governs, and pr-feedback, which triages the review feedback on the author's own PR
